title: Collapsing Timeout Failures into Uninformative Logs
pattern: Catching a network error and logging a static generic string, discarding the specific internal details of the exception.
why_bad: It throws away contextual information (e.g., port numbers, failed DNS lookups, or IP addresses) that is critical for debugging why the connection timed out, leaving operations completely blind.
detection: Logging macros in error handling blocks that print hardcoded text without formatting the wrapped error variable.
counterexample:
Clean logs formatting structural detail:
```rust
log::error!("Timeout connecting to fulfillment system: {:?}", e);
```
source: *Release It!* by Michael T. Nygard (p. 380); *Rust for Rustaceans* (p. 140).
